boundary.head: local working tree
boundary.objective: Review the complete 30-path Agent Builder autonomy and publication-planning increment plus synchronized version 1.1.1 Markdown, HTML, narration, PowerPoint, test, policy, and continuity artifacts. Confirm all six approval gates, backward-compatible contracts, non-deploying publication boundaries, generated-project propagation, accurate demo claims, and blocked P4 status.

validation.command: Read-only review of the 30-path working-tree diff and nearest controlling contracts and tests
validation.evidence: No correctness, security, compatibility, publication-boundary, requirement, evidence-integrity, or missing-test defect was identified.

All 33 focused tests passed. The 17 Agent Builder tests cover governed publication intent, invalid target-specific combinations, schema 2.1 and 2.2 approval-gate omissions, Azure Government CLI generation, identifier sanitization, and exclusion of publication metadata from rendered agent instructions.
Package-install coverage verified the updated skill, runtime, schemas, and root CLI flags in the packaged framework and a newly generated project.

validation.command: PowerPoint OOXML assertions and desktop PowerPoint rendering
validation.evidence: Demo/Project-Orchestrator-Demo.pptx is a valid 10-slide 16:9 OOXML deck. Desktop PowerPoint opened and exported every slide, and the changed slides were visually inspected without clipping, overlap, or font-substitution defects.

The mandatory repository gate passed 124 of 125 tests with one platform-specific skip, verified all 44 skills, scanned 207 files without a security failure, and verified 158 checksum-covered release-candidate files.

validation.command: git status --porcelain=v2 --branch; git diff --name-status; git diff --stat; git diff --check
validation.evidence: The frozen boundary contains 29 modified tracked paths and one untracked PowerPoint, no staged or unmerged path, and no diff-check error. Every path maps to the requested Agent Builder, demo, validation, governance, or continuity work.

residualRisks: No live Foundry endpoint, Microsoft 365 or Teams channel, Bot Service resource, Custom GPT, or GPT Action was created or exercised.

Publication readiness in Azure Government or another sovereign cloud must fail closed until current service, channel, authorization, and data-boundary availability is proven by Azure discovery and platform evidence.
The focused suite does not exercise simultaneous lock contention between two live apply processes.
Hosted CI across repository-supported platforms and Node versions can run only after the authorized branch push.
The release candidate remains unsigned and P4 requires trusted signing, distinct independent review, operational artifact evidence, revocation testing, and production verification.
recommendation: The reviewed Agent Builder and version 1.1.1 demo change set is ready for the authorized normal commit and configured feature-branch push. Do not force-push, merge, sign, release, publish, deploy, create external channel integrations, mutate Azure, or represent the unsigned candidate as production-ready.
